character: speckled rainbow trout, two pectoral fins, one dorsal, one tail fin and nothing else, proud stubborn face, human female voice out of her own mouth
cast: one fat seagull huge at the lens, greasy feathers, two wings two legs, rakes coins with its beak and screams in her face, 2.1 to 8.9; one obese carp in a gold chain, smug half-shut eyes, drifting with the current without moving a fin, from 5.7; neither speaks words
motion_rule: one leads every window and it is the trout, driving with her whole body; gull and carp move only after she hits them or while she is silent; coins keep sliding the whole window after each tail slap
camera_moves: one take, camera always with her; shot size changes four times
props: one coin mound on the fountain floor, coins sliding over the tiles, one pumped jet, low granite rim, spray on the lens; one gull, one carp; the stolen coin stays in the beak to 8.9; coins fly at the lens only from her tail slaps
environment: city fountain at a mall entrance, blazing noon sun in the spray, bright throughout, hard shadows on the water

audio.delivery: human female voice from the trout herself, weary deadpan pride, 4.4 syllables per second, never hurried, native Russian stress, no accent
audio.pacing: one unbroken phrase per window; no breath at the joins 0.7-1.6 to 1.6-2.1, 2.9-4.0 to 4.0-4.9 and 6.5-7.2 to 7.2-8.1, each one phrase over two windows; mouth opens on every syllable, silence in wordless beats

timeline.a: explodes snout first out of the coin mound into the lens, whole body clearing the water, coins and spray flung on the glass
slams her tail into the change under her, the mound fanning apart over the tiles all window
slaps her tail again, scooping the coins from below, they fly at the lens and plaster the frame
she lunges after a coin, the gull rams its beak into the lens and rips it away, she hurls her whole body at the bird and drives it back off the coins
turns her whole body on the spot, driving a wave at the gull
slaps her pectoral fin across the beak, beak flying aside with the coin
throws her whole body off the gull toward the jet, ripping the water open
spins under the gull wing, shoves the bird off with her tail and dives over a fat carp in a gold chain drifting by
breaks back up and rams her snout into the pounding jet, body arching
hammers her tail on the spot, snout in the jet, while the water pushes her back to the rim
thrashes sideways in the jet and slides back down the tiles, staring into the lens, the gull dropping out of frame with the coin
leaps into the jet, the water hurling her back down the tiles, she charges it again at full speed and hangs there going nowhere, the carp sailing past the lens the easy way

must_appear: two pectoral fins, one dorsal, one tail; coins flying at the lens; gull huge at the lens raking coins; carp drifting past and her leap into the jet at 8.9; mouth open on every syllable
negative_prompt: cyrillic, subtitles, watermark, night, dark scene, static camera, hard cut, slow motion, slow speech, human hands, extra limbs, extra fins, deformed anatomy, duplicate props, floating props, a held macro with nothing moving, the trout absent from frame, two mouths moving at once, male voice on gull or carp, accented Russian, second trout, second gull, second carp, carp beating its fins, fish walking on land, drained fountain
